name: Jogli
title: Father of the leader of the tribe of Dan
summary: Jogli is known from the Old Testament as the father of Bukki, who was appointed as the leader of the tribe of Dan. His role was connected to the distribution of the land of Canaan among the tribes of Israel. He is mentioned only briefly in the book of Numbers, but his son played an important role in the allocation of the land.

keyEvents.title: Bukki Appointed as Leader for Dan
keyEvents.description: Jogli is mentioned as the father of Bukki, who was appointed by the Lord to represent the tribe of Dan in the distribution of the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: God's Command Regarding Land Distribution
keyEvents.description: The Lord gave Moses instructions on how the land of Canaan should be distributed and appointed leaders from each tribe, including Bukki son ofogli from Dan.

keyEvents.title: Organizing the Tribal Leaders
keyEvents.description: As part of the preparations for entering the Promised Land, representatives from each tribe were chosen to oversee the distribution of the land, and Jogli's son was among them.
